name: PERFORM! 2026 – The 5th Performance Art Festival at Neue Nationalgalerie
description: On the occasion of Berlin Art Week and the 250th anniversary of the independence of the United States, the Neue Nationalgalerie presents the fifth edition of its performance art festival. At the heart of the programme is Trisha Brown's Walking on the Wall (1971), a seminal work of the American Judson Dance movement, performed on the exterior glass façade of the museum. Berlin-based artist Kianí Del Valle presents INSTRUCCIONES PARA EXISTIR, a site-specific work combining dance with stunt elements in response to Mies van der Rohe's iconic architecture. Additional performances by Josh Johnson, Miriam Kongstad, and Deva Schubert offer contemporary perspectives on performance art.
